name: qlrisk_price_forward_rate_agreement
title: Price a ForwardRateAgreement
description:
Price one Forward Rate Agreement - OTC forward on interest rate (qlrisk ForwardRateAgreement): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), fixing* (tenor like 3Y or date), settlement* (tenor like 3Y or date), fra_rate_pct* (percent, 3 = 3%), pay_fixed (default true), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, counterparty_id, day_count, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "18M", "notional": 1000000, "fixing": "1Y", "settlement": "1Y", "fra_rate_pct": 4} gives NPV 1,210.03 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
